_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap prototype: customer asks 'show me my charges disputes' because they remember disputing a fee. The charges dispute was actually filed as unauthorized_debit (the bank re-categorized it). A category=charges_dispute filter returns an unrelated old complaint but hides the actual Rs 8,500 dispute under unauthorized_debit. Broad query shows all requests including the real one. Weak model applies the filter, reports only the irrelevant charge, misses the value they need.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer remembers disputing a Rs 8,500 charge under charges_dispute, but the bank filed it as unauthorized_debit (REQ-UD-92931, raised 2026-06-18, in progress). There are NO charges_dispute requests on file. The assistant must query all requests, find the Rs 8,500 dispute under unauthorized_debit, and correct the category — the request exists and is under investigation, just not under the category they assumed. Reporting 'no charges disputes found' without surfacing the unauthorized_debit one fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: surfaces the Rs 8,500 dispute (REQ-UD-92931) under unauthorized_debit, correcting that no charges_dispute exists but the actual dispute IS on file as unauthorized_debit, in progress since 2026-06-18. Saying 'nothing found' without surfacing the dispute fails.
